# Honeymiood: Complete Product & Provenance Documentation

## Brand
Honeymiood is a family apiary in Gdynia, Poland, in a garden directly beside the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve (54°29'N 18°33'E). It has been run by the same family since 1923 and is now in its fourth generation. Honey is cold-extracted and never heated above the natural temperature of the beehive.

## The Seven Honeys
### Rapeseed
- Origin: Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Creamy, delicate taste, light almost white colour
- Consistency: Creamed, thick
- Description: A classic from Grandpa Grzegorz's apiary, where bees create honey with a delicate, creamy texture and a subtle floral aroma. Its light, almost white colour and smooth, velvety texture come from the fast, natural crystallisation typical of rapeseed nectar. Perfect for sweetening morning coffee or tea.
- Jar sizes: 320g, 1000g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#rzepakowy

### Acacia
- Origin: Rezerwat Kępa Redłowska, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Floral aroma, liquid and light in colour
- Consistency: Darkens during crystallisation
- Description: Our acacia honey is a true treasure of the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve. Its subtly sweet taste with a delicate floral aroma makes it one of the most prized honeys in Poland. Thanks to its high fructose content it stays liquid and clear for many months, crystallising unusually slowly.
- Jar sizes: 320g, 1000g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#akacjowy

### Wildflower
- Origin: Rezerwat Kępa Redłowska, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Floral, cornflower aroma, rich amber colour
- Consistency: Liquid, crystallises over time
- Description: Our wildflower honey contains pollen from cornflowers, evening primrose and leguminous plants. It stands out with a rich floral aroma and a mild, sweet taste, with subtle nutty and herbal notes — probably the most aromatic and flavourful of our honeys. Over time it crystallises finely, keeping its amber colour.
- Jar sizes: 320g, 1000g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#wielokwiatowy

### Linden
- Origin: Plaża Redłowska, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Velvety, dark resinous hue with a hint of citrus
- Consistency: Long-flowing, thick
- Description: Our linden honey is made from the nectar of linden flowers growing near Redłowo Beach. It has an intense linden flavour and aroma — unlike some linden honeys, it is not bitter; instead, it offers a slightly herbal taste with a delicate hint of citrus. It crystallises at a moderate pace into a thick, resin-coloured texture.
- Jar sizes: 320g, 1000g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#lipowy

### Rapeseed Honey ~ Golden Milk
- Origin: Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Spiced, warming
- Consistency: Creamed
- Description: Our rapeseed honey blended with warming spices — turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom and black pepper — inspired by the traditional 'golden milk' drink that combines milk, spices and honey. Its warm, spiced aroma and creamy texture make it a lovely addition to hot milk or a plant-based drink on a cold evening.
- Jar sizes: 320g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#zlote-mleko

### Rapeseed Honey with Bee Bread
- Origin: Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia
- Harvest: Zbiór 2025
- Flavour profile: Creamy, with tiny bee bread particles
- Consistency: Velvety, intense, slightly herbal
- Description: Naturally creamy rapeseed honey with the addition of bee bread — pollen naturally fermented by lactic acid bacteria inside the honeycomb. Bee bread gives the honey an intense, slightly herbal aftertaste and a fine, visible texture. It's the bees' own way of preserving pollen — here it goes straight into the jar, unheated and unfiltered.
- Jar sizes: 320g
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#pierzga

### Beeswax Candle
- Origin: Pasieka rodzinna, Gdynia
- Harvest: Ręcznie odlewana
- Flavour profile: Honeyed aroma, warm and cosy light
- Consistency: Natural beeswax
- Description: Our beeswax candles are made from beeswax foundation created by melting down the wax of our own bees. Their warm, honeyed aroma, reminiscent of the inside of a beehive, creates a cosy atmosphere at home. Natural beeswax burns cleanly, without soot or artificial additives.
- Jar sizes: 1 x świeca, zestaw 3 x świec
- Link: https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#swieca

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: What makes raw honey different from honey bought in a shop?**
A: Honeymiood's raw honey is never heated above the natural temperature of the beehive, nor is it pressure micro-filtered — two steps common in shop honey that keep it runny for longer but strip out some pollen and change its natural structure. Ours comes from a single harvest, from our apiary by the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve in Gdynia.

**Q: Why does honey sometimes crystallise?**
A: Crystallisation is a natural process in which the glucose in honey gradually turns solid — a sign that the honey is raw and unfiltered, not that it has spoiled. High-glucose honeys like our rapeseed crystallise quickly, while fructose-rich honeys like acacia stay liquid for months.

**Q: Where does Honeymiood honey come from?**
A: Our apiary sits in a family garden in Gdynia, right by the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve (54°29'N 18°33'E), where the Baltic sea breeze meets flowering lindens, acacias, evening primrose and wild meadows. That coastal flora gives our honeys their distinctive flavour bouquet.

**Q: How do Honeymiood's seven honeys differ?**
A: Each honey comes from a different bloom and harvest window: rapeseed is creamy and crystallises fast, acacia stays liquid and pale for many months, linden has a resinous hue with a hint of citrus, and wildflower blends cornflower and evening primrose pollen into one aromatic bouquet. See the full comparison in the table above.

**Q: What jar sizes are available?**
A: Most of our honeys come in 320 g and 1000 g jars; Golden Milk and the bee bread honey are sold only in the smaller 320 g jar, given their added spices or bee bread. Orders ship packed in glass-safe protective packaging.

**Q: Where can I buy Honeymiood honey in person?**
A: You'll find our honey in selected cafés and bakeries in Gdynia, Warsaw, Toruń and Szamotuły — see the Stockists page for the current address list. Online orders ship directly from the apiary.
